_note: AMBIENT1 dated config. Explicit Central Time dates only; nothing here is computed. countdown = the carved sign target on every board: whole CT calendar days to Thu Oct 29 (trick-or-treat night, so its label is Trick-or-treat); on the day the sign says Tonight. The 5:00 PM start comes from Dan's calendar event (see event) when the board's calendar feed carries it; with no matching event the sign falls back to the date alone and shows no time. halloween = the quiet Oct 31 night; end = the season is over (the ambient layer, costumes and critters do not boot, and a running page takes them down); novEnd = the November scene pack (kid boards wear the Nov plates from end until novEnd, Dec 1 12:00 AM CT).
